question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence structure requires a past tense verb to correctly align with the context provided.
 
• Option 3 "accompanied" correctly fits the past tense requirement, indicating an action that has already taken place.
 
• Other options ("accompanies", "accompany", "accompanying") do not fit the past tense context and would result in grammatical errors.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *The event was successful and was **accompanied** by a lot of celebrations.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Accompanies: This is the present tense form and does not fit the past tense context.
 
• Accompany: This is the base form and does not fit the past tense context.
 
• Accompanying: This is the present participle form and does not fit the past tense context.
